translation_loss.what_was_lost: The agglutinative suffix '-ilaana' (ஆசையிலான) fuses the noun 'desire' with a qualifying state of being, which is flattened into the English prepositional phrase 'in desire'.

The temporal suffix '-pothu' (போது) in 'kaanum pothu' is translated as 'When I saw', which introduces a past tense not explicitly marked in the same way by the non-past adjectival participle 'kaanum' (seeing/when seeing).

annotation.theme: The captivating and mesmerizing power of love and beauty.

consistency_review_findings.issue: The translation_quality is marked as 'faithful', but the stanza contains non-empty translation_loss items and a blank loss_note. When translation_loss is present, translation_quality should typically reflect partial loss or the loss_note should summarize these losses.

original_poem:
ஆசையிலான மனிதன்,  
அன்பின் விளையாட்டில் மூழ்கினான்,  
கண்ணின் அழகை காணும் போது,  
நான் மயங்கினேன்!
translated_poem:
A man in desire,  
He sank in the play of love.  
When I saw the beauty in the eyes,  
I was mesmerized!
